sourceTitle: Sweet Potato Cake With Cream Cheese Icing
sourceText:
Sweet Potato Cake With Cream Cheese Icing
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 11:22pm

Ingredients




1 pkg. yellow cake mix
4 eggs
3/4 cup sugar
Dash of nutmeg
1 teaspoon cinnamon
1/4 cup water
1/2 cup oil
1 cup mashed sweet potatoes
3 ounces cream cheese
1 stick butter
1 pound powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla
Milk

Preparation

1 Mix ingredients well. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes in a well greased tube pan. Bake only 35 minutes if using layer pans. 2 Combine ingredients and add just enough milk to make icing of spreading consistency.
